the isolation, purification, and characterization of the lipid-linked O-antigen intermediates of Salmonella newington, a bacterium that synthesizes a complex O-antigen.
the isolation and characterization of the lipid intermediates in the biosynthesis and assembly of the Salmonella enteritidis O-antigen.
the isolation, purification, and chemical characterization of lipid-linked intermediates involved with the synthesis of the Salmonella O-antigen.
